english.title: Use a motor vehicle when headlamp not lit in poor visibility / darkness
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), which was fitted with headlamps when not every such lamp was kept lit

(A)_[during the hours of darkness]_
(B)_[in seriously reduced visibility]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 25(1) of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) There is an exception for use of a vehicle during the hours of darkness on a restricted road (i.e. Restricted by virtue of a system of street lighting when it is lit). Other exceptions are contained within Regulation 25(2).
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iii) See also offence wordings: H291 and H292.
(iv) Fixed penalty scheme may be applied

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Fixed penalty ticket - Fifty pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
